evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language model (LLM) agents routinely interact with untrusted external data, exposing them to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks that hijack agents into executing attacker-chosen tasks.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Extensive evaluations across agentic benchmarks (AgentDojo and ASB) demonstrate that PIPETTE produces defenders that achieve near-zero attack success rates on static attacks and can withstand strong adaptive attacks, while maintaining benign task utility close to that of the undefended baseline.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: However, we show that achieving high ASR during red-teaming does not guarantee robustness gains from subsequent adversarial training.
